info.title: Novella Generator Actions
info.description: Interactive novel backend. No authentication required. Use getResponseChunk for large read responses.

request_id.description: Stable idempotency key for draft creation.

event_id.description: Stable unique ID for this RAW piece.

file_name.description: Source filename, when text came from a file.

path.description: Allowed filename, e.g. персонажи.json, карточки/pov.json, память/pov.json

user_input.description: Exact user input; do not paraphrase.

value.description: JSON value. Required for set, append, merge_by_id; may be a string, number, object, list, boolean or null.

updates.description: Sparse patches by actual session JSON filename.

relationship_exceptions.description: Only for a specific numeric NPC relationship change exceeding the usual 0–3 points per turn after an actual critical event.

relationship_changes.description: Optional scene-caused changes. Evaluate participants each turn; existing axis uses delta, new one uses initial_value. Server applies against stored baseline without erasing other axes.

heard_statements.description: Optional important heard speech only. Server verifies an actual public spoken quote and stores it as an attributed assertion, even if false. Never send POV thoughts.

RelationshipException.description: Explicitly documented critical change for one NPC's numeric parameter; no predefined parameter names.

owner_id.description: NPC id actually participating in scene.

delta.description: Change to existing axis; ordinary range -3..3, critical exception available.

initial_value.description: First substantive impression/new axis, never an invented automatic baseline.

quote.description: Exact public spoken phrase, never a private thought. Stored as 'speaker said ...', not as world truth.

openaiFileIdRefs.description: One attached source file provided by GPT Actions

mode.description: append: normal intake; recover: add missing source before verify; repair: replace only PLACEHOLDER

part_index.description: 0-based index of this raw byte chunk

chunk_b64.description: Standard base64 encoding of up to 12,288 ORIGINAL file bytes. Do not base64 encode a paraphrase or local path.

file_name.description: Original filename, e.g. story.txt. Keep identical across all parts.

get.description: Check server and permanent storage. If 503 or storage not writable, never create a novel; Amvera must mount /data.

storage.description: Mounted persistent volume diagnostics; no session data returned.

data_root.description: Absolute root. Must be /data for Amvera.

persistent_mount_detected.description: True if OS recognizes the volume as a mount.

writable.description: True if volume directory is writable.

post.summary: Import full original TXT directly into existing session RAW
post.description: Attach exactly one original UTF-8 TXT using openaiFileIdRefs. Send whole file directly; no summaries. Supply event_id for append.

schema.description: UUID existing session, never create another.

openaiFileIdRefs.description: One original TXT file attached to ChatGPT. GPT Actions supplies download URL automatically, never invent URL.

expected_bytes.description: Expected original UTF-8 file byte length, e.g. 113600.

expected_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 checksum of original UTF-8 bytes.

200.description: RAW accepted or repaired, with byte count and SHA-256; no original text echoed.

409.description: Mismatch, non-placeholder event, ambiguous source or closed creation.

post.summary: Safely restore original TXT over erroneous RAW PLACEHOLDER
post.description: Restore one bad PLACEHOLDER RAW source in the SAME session using one original UTF-8 TXT attachment. If known, set expected_bytes and event_id. Re-read repaired RAW and recheck JSON before verifyNovel.

schema.description: UUID existing session, never create another.

openaiFileIdRefs.description: One original TXT file attached to ChatGPT. GPT Actions supplies download URL automatically, never invent URL.

event_id.description: Optional exact erroneous RAW event_id; if omitted, auto-select only when there is one PLACEHOLDER.

expected_bytes.description: Expected original UTF-8 file byte length, e.g. 113600.

expected_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 checksum of original UTF-8 bytes.

200.description: RAW accepted or repaired, with byte count and SHA-256; no original text echoed.

409.description: Mismatch, non-placeholder event, ambiguous source or closed creation.

post.summary: Transfer exact TXT bytes in verified base64 chunks
post.description: Use only when file download_link is a local path or unusable. Read original TXT bytes; send indexed <=12,288-byte base64 parts with fixed byte count and SHA-256. Final part writes RAW only when all parts match.

schema.description: Existing session UUID. Never create another session just for upload.

200.description: Upload progress, or verified saved/restored RAW.

409.description: SHA/length mismatch, existing source conflict or wrong creation stage.
